verdict.rationale: Pika's own docs describe a lip-sync app where you upload an image plus speech or a voice recording to create an animated performance with AI lip sync. A Talking Head feature also takes a script and a presenter, or your own image and audio, so a character can speak your dialogue with matched mouth movement. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of lip-sync accuracy, documentation of limits such as clip length and multi-character dialogue, and an explicit tie between the reusable Character feature and lip sync.

support.subject: As a creator, generated characters speak my dialogue with lip movement matched to the audio

citations.quote: Upload an image and speech, music or a voice recording to create an animated performance with AI lip sync.
Add a script and choose a presenter, or use your own image and audio for explainers, demos and video messages.
Upload a speaking clip to create translated speech with voice matching and lip sync.
